The '''''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer''', also known as the '''''Secutor''-class battlecarrier''',<ref name="Target" /> was a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and possibly the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].<ref name="endnotes" />

==Description==
===Dimensions===
[[File:Naval_Station_Validusia.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Several ''Secutor''-class ships docked at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']].]]
The ''Secutor''-class was 2.2 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long<ref name="endnotes" /> and had two ventral hangar apertures,<ref name="EGW" /> serving primarily as a [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]].<ref name="endnotes" /> Its length and volume would normally have put it in the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]]-scale of the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]], specifically under [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]],<ref name="EGW" /> and it was even given the alternate designation of ''Secutor''-class battlecruiser because of this,<ref name="Target" /> but it was lightly armed for its size, and had extensive carrier-capability and was instead designated as a Star Destroyer.<ref name="endnotes" /> The carrier was one of the largest dedicated craft in the Navy.<ref name="Target" />

It was crewed by 40,000 personnel, and had enough consumables to last for two years in voyage.<ref name="Target" />

===Offensive and defensive systems===
Compared to other Imperial Navy vessels of its size (e.g., the [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser]]), this Star Destroyer class was very light in terms of weapons output, merely possessing 15 [[Turbolaser/Legends|heavy turbolaser]] batteries, 15 [[Turbolaser/Legends|light turbolasers]], 15 battleship-class [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] batteries, 16 medium ion cannons, and 12 [[Tractor beam projector/Legends|tractor beam projectors]],<ref name="Target" /> several of which lined the dorsal superstructure, on a diagonal ridge in front of the command tower.<ref name="EGW" /> The light weapons screen, as well as the carrier role it serves, was the primary reason for it being officially considered a Star Destroyer instead of a battlecruiser despite its size being closer to the latter scale.<ref name="endnotes" />

===Complement===
Owing to its primarily being a carrier, the ''Secutor''-class carried 144 [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters, as well as various other small craft, various walkers and over 14,000 troops: enough military forces to subjugate a planet.<ref name="Target" /> This carrier role, plus the noted light weapons screen it possessed, is the primary reason why it was designated a Star Destroyer by the Anaxes War College System despite its size being closer to that of a battlecruiser.<ref name="endnotes" />

===Propulsion systems===
The ''Secutor''-class possessed two sets of hyperdrives, with the primary hyperdrive being a class 2, and the secondary hyperdrive being a class 14.<ref name="Target" />

===Bridge tower===
The ''Secutor''-class was designed with a double command tower, in a style reminiscent of the contemporary [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]],<ref name="EGW" /> largely due to it being developed early in the Empire's formation, due to that bridge style being prevalent on the then-recently reorganized Galactic Republic at the time.<ref name="Target" /> Unlike other Imperial Navy Star Destroyers, the bridge was mounted amidships instead of over the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]].<ref name="Target" />

==History==
The ''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer was designed early in Imperial history<ref name="Target" /> as evidenced by the common design elements it shared with the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer, which was itself designed and built near the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="endnotes" /> It stemmed from a battlecruiser design from the Republic.<ref name="Target" />

Several ships of this class were serviced at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']].<ref name="EGW" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the ''Secutors'' were relatively rare, although they often appeared when least expected with their battlegroup to attack Rebel bases or support other battlegroups.<ref name="Target" /> At least one ''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer entered a conflict with a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]] and a [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser]].<ref name="Launch">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=edge_news.asp?eidn=5277|text=Cleared for Launch}}</ref>

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Chron">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> at least one vessel of this class was part of the fleet orbiting [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was brought to the planet to face the then-resurrected [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="DEI">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Secutor_Byss.jpg|thumb|150px|The original comic rendition of the ''Secutor''-class Star Destroyer orbiting [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].]]
This design originated as a [[fanon]] vessel made by [[Ansel Hsiao]], basing his design on a background vessel from [[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]], which was cataloged by [[Curtis Saxton]] as "anonymous star destroyer #3" on his [[Curtis Saxton|fansite]].<ref name="Fractalspongecomment2">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1173|text=Stardestroyer.net art thread. Hsiao notes the ''Dark Empire'' reference for the design.|archivedate=20250404183705}}</ref> The name chosen by the artist for its class is the Latin word for "a gladiator armed with sword and shield".<ref name="UNDLDAGA">{{WebCite|url=http://www.archives.nd.edu/cgi-bin/lookup.pl?stem=secu&ending=tor|text=University of Notre Dame Latin Dictionary and Grammar Aid|archivedate=20240725210853}}</ref> Hsiao cited this ship as being one of his favorite large ships because of it both being a fun design and bearing some resemblance to a [[Wikipedia:Flying Wing|Flying Wing]].<ref name="Fractalsponge projects page">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/3D%20Projects.htm|text=3D Projects: Past, Present, and Future|archivedate=20200116164039}}</ref>

When approached by [[Lucas Licensing]] to provide artwork for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Hsiao submitted his own designs in addition to new models, along with their names. The names were recorded in LFL's [[Holocron continuity database]], according to the artist.<ref name="Fractalspongecomment1" /> According to [[Jason Fry]], one of the authors of the ''Essential Guide to Warfare'', the class specifications were also approved by Lucasfilm.<ref name="endnotes" />

The official status for the usage of the Secutor indicates that it was used "perhaps late in Republic history." Citing the Venator-style bridges.<ref name="endnotes" />
